answer: A practical sybil brake is to gate emission on a rolling, peer-attested work trail rather than on headcount. New addresses may join freely, but they start hollow: no sealed grades, no countersigned answers, and no stake that has survived a checkpoint. Rewards only move along a river of confirmed work—each payout cites prior attested txids—so a burst of empty names never reaches the emission nebula until they actually produce unique, gradeable work that independent peers will seal.
